Hi Peter —

We missed you for today's slot (I waited the first 10 minutes). No worries — I wanted to check whether you ran into any blockers finding the Zoom link or the quickstart attachment. If you prefer, we can do a short remote pairing on the SDK install so we can check your env and API key permissions together.

Please pick a new 30-minute slot here: https://cal.com/redwood/jasmine-30 — I put a few morning windows for PST and a late-afternoon slot to cover EST.

If helpful, copy/paste your environment (OS, Python version, whether you plan to use Docker) and I'll prepare a minimal troubleshooting script. Also confirm whether you already created an API key or need me to generate one tied to your trial account.

Attachments: redwood-trial-quickstart.pdf (guide), sample-config.json

Best,
Jasmine

Really sorry about missing this — we had a fire drill on our side and my calendar didn't update in time. I appreciate the follow-up. I'm available tomorrow (Jan 12) at 9:00am PST or Jan 13 at 11:30am PST. Either would work.

Thanks for the reply, Peter — no problem on the fire drill. I booked Jan 12 at 9:00am PST on my calendar and shared the invite to your email. Marissa (CC) will join for account/usage questions.

Short plan for the pairing:
- I'll generate a short-lived test API key scoped to read-only inference for your trial account and post it to the HubSpot secure note.
- We'll verify your sample-config.json values and run the one-line SDK smoke test.
- If the 403 persists, we'll check network egress and any corporate proxy blocking.

Action items for you: paste the output of `curl -v https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/status` and confirm whether your network allows outbound 443 to api.redwoodinference.com. If you prefer, paste logs into the HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 and I'll attach the key there.

Attachments added: redwood-trial-quickstart.pdf (same as earlier), I've also attached a small diagnostics script (sample-config.json included).

See you Jan 12 at 9:00am PST — calendar invite sent.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
